Rita: Live from the all-hands chat // drop your hottest one-liners and GIFs :sparkles:
Omar: That kickoff slide was a whole cinematic trailer. someone send popcorn. :popcorn:
Nina: GIF: https://media.giphy.com/media/5GoVLqeAOo6PK/giphy.gif (drama)
Theo: Quick take: quarterly goals look spicy. also, who brought snacks? :eyes:
Chris: I brought leftover pizza (virtual slice for everyone) :pizza: note: I will defend pineapple to the end. :pineapple:
Olivia: Short & sweet: huge kudos to @Nina for the product demo timing 00% on point :clap:
Rita: plus one for ops team 00% smooth deploy. you all deserve donuts.
DeployBot: Deploy OK 1: no rollbacks. nice work team.
Omar: Meme posted: "when the roadmap says 'ship faster' and the squad says 'hold my coffee'" (posted)
Theo: Poll: storm the background parade? vote :thumbsup: for themed backgrounds, :thumbsdown: for stealth mode.
Nina: :thumbsup: themed backgrounds forever. I made a lighthouse background.
Chris: :thumbsdown: low-bandwidth Karen here. also, bless the mute button.
Olivia: Also reminder: trivia tonight at 7PT 1 bring your worst dad jokes.
Rita: If you win trivia you get bragging rights and a custom emoji 389
ConfettiBot: Automatic confetti in 3...2...1... :confetti_ball: :confetti_ball:
Omar: Everyone spam :tada: :clap: :sparkles:
Theo: One-liner takeaway: metrics look like a gentle rollercoaster. aesthetic and stable.
Chris: Can someone clip the mic-drop at the end? absolute chef's kiss. :kissing_heart:
Nina: I'll add it to the highlight reel. also coffee next week on me (virtual vouchers) :coffee:
Rita: Closing: that was peak team energy. see y'all at the post-all-hands meme channel. :wink:
